|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Destiny + 2 when drawn for weapon or battle destiny. While armed with a Blaster Rifle, forfeit + 2 and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Stormtrooper (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “''When drawn for weapon or battle destiny, destiny +2.'' While present at a site and armed with a blaster rifle, forfeit +2 and draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.” '''What changed:''' “Destiny + 2 when” → “''When”; “destiny.” → “destiny, destiny +2.''”; added “present at a site and”; “Blaster Rifle,” → “blaster rifle,”; “+ 2” → “+2”; “not able” → “unable”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 45. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Stormtrooper]].
* Later text: [[Stormtrooper (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
